definitions.gloss: valuables; precious items; personal effects of value
definitions.explanation: Items of monetary or personal value such as wallets, jewelry, passports, and electronics. Commonly referenced in travel, security, and storage contexts.

examples.japanese: {貴重品|きちょうひん}は{身|み}につけてください。
examples.english: Please keep your valuables on your person.

examples.japanese: {貴重品|きちょうひん}はフロントに{預|あず}けられます。
examples.english: Valuables can be left at the front desk.

examples.japanese: {車内|しゃない}に{貴重品|きちょうひん}を{置|お}いたまま{離|はな}れないでください。
examples.english: Please do not leave valuables in the car when you step away.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common word seen on signs in hotels, locker rooms, pools, and public facilities. Frequently appears in safety warnings and travel advisories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貴重品|きちょうひん}を{預|あず}ける (to deposit valuables)
- {貴重品|きちょうひん}の{管理|かんり} (management of valuables)
- {貴重品|きちょうひん}ロッカー (valuables locker)
- {貴重品|きちょうひん}{入|い}れ (valuables case/pouch)

WORD FORMATION:
{貴重|きちょう} (precious, valuable) + {品|ひん} (item, goods).
